description: No one in the organization is specifically recruited or recognized for security passion; champions, if they exist, were assigned without regard to genuine interest.
A few individuals show personal interest in security, but there is no deliberate effort to recruit or nurture that passion.
The organization actively looks for passionate volunteers when staffing the champions program, rather than assigning people by default.
Passionate champions are consistently recruited, given visible opportunities to grow, and job postings highlight the organization's security culture.

Passion for security is part of the company's DNA at every level, actively cultivated through recruitment, visible management sponsorship, and continuous opportunities for champions to grow their curiosity.
